_comment: JSON has no comments; this key is accepted and ignored by run_mode.py.
models.override: null is NOT 'no override' - it resolves from run.speed.
run.speed fast    -> astra-all: every role, reviewers included, runs the
hard model (the owner's full speed rule of 2026-09-12;
review is a semantic-alignment phase and needs it).
Write "policy" to keep the published policy during a fast run, or
"astra-all" to force the hard model at default speed. run_mode.py set speed
re-resolves the field, so the tier and the models never disagree, and
run_mode.py get model_override answers with what is actually in force.
run.compute.offload_hosts names the extra build hosts this run may use.
chsh is the aarch64 build farm; the owner's rule is that it is used in
full speed mode and NEVER otherwise, so run_mode.py get offload is yes
only when run.speed is fast, the host is listed and the run is not
paused. Remove the key (or the host) for a run that must stay on ghz.
